records.school_config.json: Configuration JSON; student_groups[].current_bell_time etc. are ISO 8601 with timezone; counts are students; seed is integer.
records.pickup_zones.json: Zone objects include length in metres, capacities in vehicles by type, time windows as local HH:MM:SS, flags boolean.
records.constraints.json: constraint_type is hard|soft; references group and zone IDs; parameters are JSON objects.
records.synthetic_scenarios.json: scenario_id unique; multipliers are dimensionless; compliance_probability is [0,1]; random_seed integer.
records.data_dictionary.json: Defines file field names, types, units, allowed values, nullability, and relationships.
